title: 23 Objective Memory and Verified Transition Graph (VTG)
summary: Defines the Objective Memory layer and Verified Transition Graph (VTG), a verified cognitive execution substrate storing reusable low-entropy transitions with candidate frontiers, learning events, and privacy scoping.
notes: No frontmatter, no ADR status/decision sections, no user stories. Lives in docs/architecture/ with substantial design-rationale prose (DOC signal), but dominant signals are SPEC: JSON edge and learning-event schemas, state_id hash/HMAC construction, storage stack contracts, update semantics, security/privacy NFRs, and tracked performance metrics. SPEC chosen over DOC per precedence rule; content-signals-only confidence.
